# `mail` — `/api/mail`

The host's mail: their mailbox over IMAP and SMTP, or a local Thunderbird profile, for the Mail page (host only, and only while the host's tools are on).

Served only with the host's tools on (`GROVE_HOST_TOOLS` not `off`); otherwise every route here answers 404.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/mail/accounts`](#get-api-mail-accounts) | Host | Returns list of {id, label} for each IMAP account that has a local INBOX. |
| GET | [`/api/mail/inbox`](#get-api-mail-inbox) | Host | Return inbox messages via live IMAP if configured, else local Thunderbird mbox. |
| POST | [`/api/mail/launch`](#post-api-mail-launch) | Host | Launch Thunderbird in the specified view (mail, calendar, or compose). |
| GET | [`/api/mail/message/{account}/{idx}`](#get-api-mail-message-account-idx) | Host | Fetch full message body by account and sequence number. |
| POST | [`/api/mail/send`](#post-api-mail-send) | Host | Sends an email from the host's mailbox (host only). |
| GET | [`/api/mail/unread`](#get-api-mail-unread) | Host | Returns the live UNSEEN count from the IMAP server. |

<a id="get-api-mail-accounts"></a>
### `GET /api/mail/accounts`

Returns list of {id, label} for each IMAP account that has a local INBOX.

- Handler: [`get_accounts`](../../../backend/routers/mail.py)
- Served only with the host's tools on (`GROVE_HOST_TOOLS` not `off`); otherwise every route here answers 404
- Who may call: The host

**Response**

- `200`: JSON list, each item JSON object with `id`, `label`
- `200`: empty JSON list

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 403 | Host access required. | `administrator` |
| 404 | Not found | `host_tools` |

<a id="post-api-mail-send"></a>
### `POST /api/mail/send`

Sends an email from the host's mailbox (host only).

- Handler: [`send_email`](../../../backend/routers/mail.py)
- Served only with the host's tools on (`GROVE_HOST_TOOLS` not `off`); otherwise every route here answers 404
- Who may call: The host

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `SendRequest`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `to` | string | yes |  | at least 3 characters; at most 254 characters |
| `subject` | string | no | `""` | at most 500 characters |
| `body` | string | yes |  | at most 200000 characters |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `ok`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Sending is not configured. Set MAIL_SMTP_HOST and MAIL_SMTP_USER in .env. | `send_email` |
| 403 | Host access required. | `administrator` |
| 404 | Not found | `host_tools` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 502 | Could not send: {e} | `send_email` |
